evidence.note: AdaNav introduces an Uncertainty-Adaptive Reasoning Block that dynamically triggers extra reasoning during vision-language navigation based on action-entropy metrics, trained via a Heuristics-to-RL methodology that lets agents learn difficulty-aware reasoning policies from only 6,000 samples, outperforming closed-source models trained on far larger datasets.
evidence.title: AdaNav: Adaptive Reasoning with Uncertainty for Vision-Language Navigation
